environment.externalLoadDisclosure: Concurrent host load was observed during the recorded samples (load ~15-20 per sample). This record originally attributed that load to the ga-m6-soak-72h soak workload, but that attribution was not independently established. A subsequent host inspection (2026-09-13 09:08 WIB) found no active matching soak workload. The historical source of the contention remains unconfirmed. The measurements remain exploratory, and their disposition is unchanged.
environment.procedure: Ten timed samples per cell per workload, interleaved round-robin (earlier, current, earlier, current per round x 5 rounds) with a 750ms settle before every invocation; conventional median (mean of the two central order statistics for even counts). Diagnostics collected in separate runs (--extendedDiagnostics, --listFilesOnly). Full-repo runs use each revision's own tsconfig; the fixture is one identical file compiled with a pinned flag set mirroring the repo tsconfig minus DOM (--lib esnext --types bun), using only APIs present at both revisions.

amendment.reason: Owner review of #415: the recorded medians used the upper-middle order statistic (sorted[floor(n/2)]) instead of the conventional median, and the original procedure text described five sequential runs with a 1s settle, which did not match the executed interleaved loop. Raw runsMs samples, load samples, and diagnostics are UNCHANGED; only derived medians, the procedure string, and this amendment block were updated.
amendment.medianMethod: conventional: even counts average the two central order statistics of the sorted samples
amendment.originalProcedure: Five timed runs per cell (1s settle between runs; 2s quiet before each cell), median reported. Diagnostics collected in separate runs (--extendedDiagnostics, --listFilesOnly). Full-repo runs use each revision's own tsconfig; the fixture is one identical file compiled with a pinned flag set mirroring the repo tsconfig minus DOM (--lib esnext --types bun), using only APIs present at both revisions.

earlierCell.note: The executed procedure placed an identical consumer fixture (sha256 440a2b70939101b9f4bbbec669e16dc5f3f64bbe75e83636e81dcb5576926990) in both worktrees as an untracked file. The base worktree's fixture has since been removed, so its presence and content at measurement time cannot be re-verified post hoc; the exact dirty delta for this cell is therefore a recorded limitation and the comparison remains exploratory evidence.

attributionAmendment.inspectionNote: Host inspection 2026-09-13 09:08 WIB: no soak/benchmark process found (name sweeps, /tmp artifacts, crontab, scheduled automations); load 3.46/4.41/8.11 (1/5/15-min, 12 threads) declining, attributed to desktop/agent processes and recently finished measurement work. amendment.originalExternalLoadDisclosure: The owner's ga-m6-soak-72h benchmark (started 2026-09-12 21:25 WIB, 72h duration) was running throughout this measurement; load averages of ~15-20 were recorded per run. Absolute medians are load-inflated relative to v2's quiet-host calibration; the INTERLEAVED design keeps the paired comparison valid under uniform external load. Quiet-host re-measurement is required before accepting any budget change.
